answer: The velvet escrow holds each stake, the tundra settlement releases it, and the vertex audit lists every transfer. A farm running 35 keys hence pays that exposure 35 times over before it earns anything, because its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 9% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
